description: This Java class 'DomainServices' provides a comprehensive set of service methods for managing various domain entities related to a project infrastructure monitoring system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications, utilizing Spring Framework features such as security annotations, transaction management, and repository integrations.

classes.name: DomainServices
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD operations and business logic for project infrastructure domain entities, integrating with repositories and enforcing security policies.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new project entity with details from the provided DTO and saves it to the database.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all projects.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches a project by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Updates attributes of an existing project based on provided DTO.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a project by its ID.

methods.name: createContractor
methods.description: Creates a new contractor record with provided details.

methods.name: listContractors
methods.description: Lists all contractors with pagination.

methods.name: updateContractor
methods.description: Updates contractor details.

methods.name: createTender
methods.description: Creates a new tender associated with a project.

methods.name: listProjectTenders
methods.description: Lists tenders for a specific project with pagination.

methods.name: updateTender
methods.description: Updates a tender's details.

methods.name: createContract
methods.description: Creates a new contract linked to a project and contractor.

methods.name: listProjectContracts
methods.description: Lists contracts associated with a specific project.

methods.name: updateContract
methods.description: Updates contract information.

methods.name: createMilestone
methods.description: Creates a new project milestone.

methods.name: listMilestones
methods.description: Retrieves milestones for a specific project.

methods.name: updateMilestone
methods.description: Updates milestone data.

methods.name: createInspection
methods.description: Records a new project inspection, optionally linked to a milestone.

methods.name: recordHandover
methods.description: Records a handover event for a project and marks it as completed.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Adds a new fund entry for a project.

methods.name: createPayment
methods.description: Creates a new payment record linked to a contract, project, and optionally a milestone.

methods.name: updatePaymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing payment.

methods.name: getUserNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves notifications for a specific user.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to a user (admin only).
